'''Stuart Marsh''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 11th at [[July 2000 Hatfield tournament]] on 16 July 2000 with Yavin 4 Leia deck, according to Jamie Giberti's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1022">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-19-hatfield-england-7-16-00d1022/ hatfield-england-7-16-00], DeckTech (Jamie "JEEBS" Giberti, 19 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-19-hatfield-england-7-16-00d1022/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
